Insertion slots omit the insertions at their own center position. Native unknown code20 is also indistinguishable from traceback gap20. Both faults must be addressed without weakening HMMER source/profile checks.
hypothesis: Preserving every native-encoded source residue in center-star projection yields valid family profiles and permits a controlled HMMER comparison; any accuracy benefit remains an empirical question.
